summary: Practise child-centred case management, safeguarding and social assistance referrals. Explore the five-day course and its applied casework.
lede: Child welfare and social protection training helps practitioners connect child-centred casework with family support and available assistance. Designed for social workers, child protection officers and programme coordinators, it covers practical decisions and follow-up across cases. You practise best-interests assessment, child-centred case planning and referrals, alongside safeguarding checks and spreadsheet tracking of actions and review dates.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course is designed for practitioners who assess child protection concerns, coordinate services or connect vulnerable households with social protection support. It suits you if your work includes case decisions, referral follow-up, safeguarding or oversight of child-focused programmes.
modules: Child Protection Systems and Social Protection Floors
Guidelines for the Alternative Care of Children
ILO Social Protection Floors and Inclusion
Child Protection Minimum Standards Case Review
prerequisites: Working knowledge of child welfare, child protection or social assistance delivery is expected. Experience handling referrals, family support plans or programme records will help you apply the case exercises. No coding or programming is required.
